sections.title: Hopf Algebra
sections.extract: The objective here is to summarize a demonstration of the relationship between our model and a Hopf algebra. Briefly, if we can associate the process of fusion with the Hopf algebraic operation of multiplication and the process of fission with the operation of comultiplication we have two essential components of a bialgebra, and with the inclusion of an antipode, the essential elements of a Hopf algebra [8,14].
